import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w=np.pi/10
    return (params[0] + params[1]*v + params[2]*x + params[3]*x**2 + params[4]*v**2
            + params[5]*np.sqrt(v) + params[6]*np.log(x)*np.sqrt(v) + params[7]*np.exp(-x)
            + params[8]*np.cos(w*t) + params[9]*np.sin(w*t))
